title: 管理員審核後台 → 真實數據串接 (前端)
acceptance: Replace placeholder 'Module Under Development' in /admin/enrolments with real data table
Table columns: enrollee name, course name, enrollment type, payment method, payment status badge, submitted date, actions
Payment proof preview: click row → modal/drawer with image loaded via presigned GET URL
Approve button: calls PATCH /api/admin/enrolments/[id] with action=APPROVE, shows success toast
Reject button: opens confirm dialog with optional reason textarea, calls PATCH with action=REJECT
Status filter tabs: All / Pending / Verified / Rejected — filters API query
Loading state: skeleton table rows while data fetches
Empty state: 'No enrolments found' message with icon
verification: Visit /en/admin/enrolments → table loads with real enrolments. Click 'Approve' → row updates to VERIFIED. Click payment proof → S3 image shown in modal. Filter by 'Rejected' → only rejected rows shown.
